name: Kylan
source:
Claiming to be a retired vassal, Kylan is a mysterious person who likes to poke his nose in other people's business. With a brilliant, inquisitive mind and a thirst for knowledge that is never satisfied, Kylan spends his days researching into magic, science and the like. Perhaps partly due to his terrifying intellect, which gives him the ability to analyze people to a great degree of accuracy, Kylan can be very charismatic and manipulative when he wants to be. Despite his charm, Aliya can't quite shake off the feeling that he isn't what he appears to be. What could this eccentric inventor be hiding?

[From [url=https://ebullience-games.itch.io/airis]itch.io[/url]]
